I managed to pick up a copy of this game for about $17 , having seen the mixed reviews from people and read all about the frustrating kickstarter events, I still thought it looked cool and really reminded me of Resident Evil (why there is not an actual boardgame themed around RE I do not know!). After removing myself from all the kickstarter shenanigans and downloaded an updated rule set, me and the wife sat down and gave it a play, right out of the box. Immediately we noticed two things - we were having fun and the rulebook that came with the game was all over the place! We soon died (possibly due to missing a few important rules) and afterwards I sat down and re-wrote the rulebook from front to back in a much more sequential order so that it was easier to check rules at a glance. My point is that, having not spent hundreds of dollars on the kickstarter and only picked this up for £17 dollars, I think this is a pretty fun game that really captures RE and almost plays like a video game (what with the final showdown and all). The miniatures are not great, but as this didn't cost so much, I really don't mind. The game actually works pretty smoothly once you get your head around the rules and there is some great potential to turn this into a full Resident Evil game by making your own custom Character cards and minis. Has anyone else found, that once you take the kickstarter shitstorm out of the equation and forget about the expansions that may never be available, this is a really cool game? We like it a lot!
